protected_void_single_override.new_rule: Preserve the mount-part central bore wall and void. Full-assembly connectivity must match the frozen source assembly. If the backing originally blocks the path, runtime is not required to excavate that source material.

representation_equivalence.runtime_geometry_truth: The frozen vertices and faces of the same346 convex entities. No candidate coordinates or faces may be modified or snapped.
representation_equivalence.halfspaces_role: Analysis/verification representation. Infinite-precision literal binary64 halfspace coefficients need not form perfect seam topology.
representation_equivalence.equivalence_rule: A closure gap or overlap <=1e-7mm is an equivalent boundary representation only when it creates no effective solid/void region exceeding1e-7mm. Any larger effective boundary remains subject to the original A/B/C fidelity rules.
representation_equivalence.evidence_requirement: A waiver requires local geometric support/containment or interval evidence bounding the discrepancy, not merely a small floating residual. Mixed or unbounded regions remain UNKNOWN.
unchanged_constraints: Frozen Tier C source domains and material-set<=0.05mm

application_rule: Load the exact inherited Git blob, replace only central_through_bore.rule, and add the representation-equivalence interpretation above. All other inherited rules remain byte-value identical.
acceptance: No acceptance result exists in this rules-only commit. Reacceptance starts only after this commit is created.
